Name: Seeded Harbour-level fixture and pump-command check
Description: A deterministic fixture seeds both redundant harbour-level sensors to 110 cm long enough for Guardian and Brain to poll, judge, and respond. This is not authentic field telemetry.
Expected: Twin: At tick 1, SensorBank samples 110.0 cm for PRT-WLV-01 and its registered redundant sensor PRT-WLV-02. The seeded observations remain available for a 40-tick review window. The fixture does not apply rain or mutate CityCore B-01.
Expected: Guardian: The normal Guardian poller receives both new readings. The matching pair corroborates the rise; verdicts remain the authority for whether Brain may act.
Expected: Brain: The normal Brain poller detects the sustained harbour flood, requests the Guardian verdict, and sends a pump command only after a trusted verdict. Twin checks and applies the command through its existing safety contract.
How to verify: Start the Compose stack, launch SCN-02 in the Twin dashboard, then compare the same sensor observation in the Guardian and Brain timelines. A Brain command must show APPLIED in the Twin action history; otherwise inspect the Guardian verdict and Brain decision reason.
